lists.text: What you'll do:
lists.content:
• Own a category portfolio of creator affiliates — recruit, onboard, brief, and coach creators to drive content and GMV.
  • Drive SKU activation: identify uncovered high-opportunity SKUs and get creator video live on them.
  • Coordinate sample seeding and creator onboarding in partnership with the ops team.
  • Brief creators on product hooks and content angles that convert — not just awareness.
  • Track performance at the creator and SKU level; optimize based on what the data shows.
  • Partner with the Brand Growth team on brand-specific creator activations and campaigns.
  • Contribute to weekly business reviews with performance data and creator pipeline updates.

lists.text: How you show up:
lists.content:
• Proactive communicator — creators, internal partners, and leadership never have to chase you.
  • Thinks like an owner — if a creator isn't posting or a SKU has no content, you fix it.
  • Uses data to prioritize — you know which SKUs and which creator tiers move the needle.
  • Builds relationships that last — genuine creator partnerships, not transactional one-and-dones.
  • Brings creative instincts — you understand what performs on TikTok and coach toward it.
  • Embraces ambiguity — the creator economy moves fast and you move with it.

lists.text: What experiences will help you:
lists.content:
• 2+ years in creator/influencer marketing, affiliate program management, or ecommerce.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and manage external relationships.
  • Data-comfortable — you know which metrics matter and how to act on them.
  • Strong communicator with creators and internal stakeholders.
  • Self-starter who can manage a high-volume roster independently.
  • Active TikTok user who understands how content performs on the platform.

lists.text: Preferred experience:
lists.content:
• TikTok Shop affiliate experience — seeding, commission structures, content briefing.
  • Creator CRM tools (Circle, Grin, Impact, Aspire, or similar).
  • Ecommerce or marketplace background (Amazon, Walmart, DTC)..
  • Category knowledge in home, outdoor, sports, tools, or adjacent consumer goods.
  • Performance-based creator program experience — not just awareness campaigns.

lists.text: How will you achieve success:
lists.content:
• Build a $50M+ GMV book of business as the senior leader on the team — this isn't a supporting role; you carry a pipeline and a number.
  • Independently build your ICP and source your own targets — no reliance on inbound or handoffs; you identify the right brands and the right contacts, and you drive the relationship from day one.
  • Run your pipeline with the same rigor a leader would expect from a team — disciplined CRM and KPI management to prioritize the vendors most likely to close, reflecting the standard you'd set if you were managing others.
  • Shape pitch strategy at a senior level — tailoring approach across SMB and Enterprise, category by category, with the judgment of someone who's operated close to the top of a BD org.
  • Report your GMV and close performance directly to senior leadership — your results carry real visibility into the business, functioning as a benchmark for what strong individual performance looks like at Spreetail.

lists.text: What experiences will help you in this role:
lists.content:
• Proven ability to close cross-border partnerships with Chinese manufacturers entering the US market — backed by fluency in Mandarin and English, with the negotiation instincts to navigate both language and cultural dynamics solo.
  • A track record of personally closing $50M+ GMV deals — 8+ years of hands-on ownership from first outreach through signature, operating at a strategic deal size that reflects this role's seniority.
  • Deep knowledge of ecommerce fulfillment and marketplace operations — able to speak credibly to how a brand's products move from vendor onboarding through Amazon, Walmart, or Target fulfillment, so you can sell the full value of the partnership, not just the deal terms.
  • Trade show sourcing and P&L/costing negotiation experience — comfortable prospecting in person and managing the financial mechanics of a deal, from program terms to margin trade-offs.
  • C-suite and owner-level selling experience — comfortable pitching and closing directly with founders, National VPs of Sales, and SMB owners, adjusting your approach deal by deal.

You’ll work cross-functionally to embed compliance into every stage of the supply chain while influencing key business decisions through data and risk mitigation. Success requires someone who acts with urgency, communicates with clarity, and embraces challenges as opportunities to raise the bar. lists.text: How you will achieve success:
lists.content:
• Develop strong cross-functional relationships by conducting 1:1s with Legal, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, and external partners to align on compliance priorities and business needs.
  • Quickly assess and document the current state of trade compliance by reviewing core materials, classification accuracy, and import/export activity, identifying key gaps and opportunities.
  • Drive immediate impact through early wins, including correcting recordkeeping errors, improving broker SOPs, and resolving classification discrepancies that drive cost.
  • Establish performance baselines by launching a draft KPI dashboard to measure classification accuracy, entry timeliness, and screening compliance.
  • Shape the long-term compliance strategy by building a phased roadmap, designing targeted training, and presenting a savings-aligned compliance plan to leadership.

lists.text: What experiences will help you in this role:
lists.content:
• Extensive trade compliance background, including classification, valuation, licensing, and audit processes, ideally in a high-volume import/export environment.
  • Proven success leading cross-functional compliance projects involving brokers, logistics providers, and internal stakeholders across legal, finance, and supply chain.
  • Strong analytical and systems expertise, including experience with ACE, AES, ECCN/HTS tools, and denied party screening software.
  • History of delivering cost savings through duty optimization strategies such as FTA use, duty drawback, First Sale for Export, and process improvements.
  • Executive communication skills with a track record of presenting risk assessments, dashboards, and strategic roadmaps to senior leadership.

The Safety team exists to protect Spreetail’s most important asset — our people. The Safety Manager drives a proactive safety culture by owning both the strategic oversight and the hands-on, day-to-day execution of safety programs across the fulfillment center. This role doesn’t just manage from a desk — it is a floor-level presence that conducts walk-throughs, leads incident investigations, delivers training, and ensures compliance is lived, not just documented. In the absence of dedicated Safety Supervisors, the Safety Manager personally carries out the full breadth of responsibilities required to keep every associate safe and every program audit-ready.

lists.text: How you will achieve success:
lists.content:
• Ownership of key ORIR & LTI rates, currently trending at or below industry benchmarks for warehouse and e-fulfillment operations — and you own the data, support an integrated Operations team in determining the root cause, and drive the corrective and preventative actions to completion. 
  • Every OSHA recordable is documented accurately, investigated thoroughly, and corrective actions are closed on time — with integrated Operations support and engagement. 
  • Support P&C in ensuring new hire and PIT safety training completion is at or above 95% for all associates and departments at all times — ensure onboarding safety training is completed before a new hire’s first shift on the floor.
  • Monthly safety audits are conducted, scored, and open items are tracked to closure — audit results are consistently improving quarter-over-quarter.
  • Emergency response plans, evacuation procedures, and first aid resources are current, posted, and practiced regularly across all shifts.
  • Workers’ compensation claims are actively managed — modified duty programs are utilized, claims are reported on time, and costs are trending down.

lists.text: What experiences will help you in this role:
lists.content:
• 3+ years of safety or EHS experience, ideally in a production, warehouse, distribution center, or e-fulfillment environment.
  • Formal or extensive regulatory experience and exposure. Responsibility for 300 logs, complaints, and onsite support.  
  • Experience supporting multi-shift operations, including night or weekend shifts.
  • Direct, hands-on experience conducting Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), safety audits, incident investigations, and root cause analyses.
  • Proven ability to own and execute integrated safety programs independently — this role does not have Safety Supervisor support and requires someone who can carry the management, influence/cooperations, and the execution.
  • Comfortable as a floor-level presence: a significant portion of each shift is spent on the warehouse floor, not behind a desk.

  • Experience as part of a small team, preferably in Indian startups 
  • Experience in B2B and e-commerce would be preferred
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in ambiguity with rapid iteration cycles. 
  • Demonstrated success in influencing cross-functional partners, including Product, Analytics, Merch Ops, and executive stakeholders.

lists.text: How you will achieve success:
lists.content:
• Make Safety the Standard: Build and sustain a safety-first culture at your home FC and across every site in your regional assignment. Lead safety training, conduct walk-throughs, reinforce safe behaviors at every level, and drive near-miss reporting culture. Every site you touch should be safer after your visit than before it. 
  • Own Onboarding Quality: Design, deliver, and continuously improve the onboarding experience at your home FC. Every new associate and leader should hit the floor knowing what they need to succeed. Onboarding quality is your leading indicator for safety, retention, and execution. 
  • Build and Maintain the Training Library: Develop, document, and own the training programs, SOPs, and job instructions that define Spreetail's operating model. Your materials become the network standard — they must be accurate, accessible, and actually used. 
  • Drive Compliance Across Your Region: Audit training completion and safety compliance at your home FC and assigned regional FCs. Identify gaps, build corrective plans, track completion, and hold sites accountable. Travel within your region a minimum of 25% of the time to deliver this work in person. 
  • Build a Culture That Retains People: Develop and execute retention programs that connect associates to meaningful outcomes through development, recognition, and engagement. Treat onboarding quality and learning culture as your primary retention levers. 
  • Connect Learning to Operational Performance: Partner with site leadership to identify where execution gaps trace back to training quality or learning curve. Build targeted interventions that improve efficiency, quality, and cost — and measure whether they worked. 
  • Deploy When the Network Needs You: During periods of high onboarding volume, major operational initiatives, or when a site becomes a focus, deploy as part of the Away Team to provide direct operational support. You go where the need is greatest, regardless of whether it is your home FC. 
  • Support Facility Launches: When Spreetail opens a new fulfillment center, you are part of the team that stands it up — bringing training infrastructure, onboarding programs, and safety culture from day one.

lists.content:
• Multiple years of progressive experience in high-volume fulfillment, manufacturing, or distribution; e-commerce expertise strongly preferred 
  • 3+ years in a leadership capacity with demonstrated ability to develop frontline associates and supervisors 
  • Proven track record of building safety-first cultures — safety is a leadership value you have demonstrated in practice 
  • Hands-on experience building or managing training programs, onboarding curriculum, or learning initiatives in an operational environment 
  • Demonstrated ability to improve retention and engagement in a high-velocity warehouse environment 
  • Experience working across multiple sites or functions; ability to build trust quickly in new environments 
  • Strong ability to document complex operational processes into clear, accurate, usable SOPs and training materials 
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills; ability to connect learning gaps to operational outcomes 
  • Willingness to travel a minimum of 25% of the time within an assigned region; available for deployment to critical-need facilities when needed

lists.text: How will you achieve success:
lists.content:
• Preventative Maintenance: Perform scheduled preventative maintenance on material handling equipment (MHE), conveyors and conveyance systems, storage racking, and facility infrastructure (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and life-safety systems) as permitted by municipal code. 
  • Corrective Maintenance: Diagnose equipment failures and respond to downtime events with urgency to restore operations safely and efficiently. Execute hands-on repairs and coordinate external vendors when issues exceed onsite capabilities. Hands-on repairs can include Conveyance, PIT, Racking.
  • Facilities & Operations Support: Serve as the on-site facilities point of contact for warehouse leadership. Partner with operations teams to minimize disruption during repairs and maintenance activities. Support facility readiness for peak, expansion, and new equipment deployments. 
  • Asset & CMMS Management: Maintain accurate asset registries for MHE, conveyance, racking, spare parts, and facility systems. Use a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to track work orders and preventative maintenance schedules, document repairs and downtime events, and support lifecycle planning and capital replacement decisions. 
  • Team & Vendor Oversight: Interface with third-party service providers for specialized maintenance, inspections, and repairs and manage a team of temporary or contract housekeepers/janitorial staff. Oversee day-to-day task execution, scheduling, and performance of on-site support labor. 
  • Compliance: Ensure compliance with safety standards, OSHA requirements, and internal policies.

lists.text: What experiences will help you in this role:
lists.content:
• 3+ years of experience as an industrial, facilities, or maintenance technician in a warehouse, distribution, manufacturing, or similar environment 
  • Hands-on experience maintaining and repairing conveyor and sortation systems, material handling equipment, and industrial facility systems. 
  • Formal technical education, certifications, or training in areas such as conveyor system repair and maintenance, Powered Industrial Trucks (PIT), and electrical or mechanical systems. 
  • Strong working knowledge of MEP principles (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) 
  • Familiarity with CMMS platforms (e.g., Limble, MaintainX, UpKeep, Maximo, Fiix) 
  • Experience supervising contractors or temporary labor.
  • Experience working in fast-paced, uptime-critical environments.

Join our Procurement Operations team and play a key role in keeping our supply chain running smoothly! 
In this role, you’ll process purchase orders and invoices with accuracy, support vendor documentation and compliance, and collaborate closely with teams across Finance, Fulfillment, and Inbound. You’ll gain hands-on experience with procurement systems like NetSuite or SAP while building foundational skills for career growth. If you have a sharp eye for detail, strong organizational skills, and a passion for operational excellence, this is a great opportunity to grow your career in a fast-paced, global environment.

lists.text: How will you achieve success:
lists.content:
• Accurately processes purchase orders and supplier invoices, ensuring all data is entered correctly in internal systems and aligns with contractual terms. 
  • Supports procurement operations by collecting and verifying vendor documentation, quotes, and pricing to ensure compliance with internal controls and approval workflows. 
  • Uploads and validates invoices in the appropriate platforms, ensuring coding accuracy and alignment with purchase orders and receipts.
  • Monitors open purchase orders and delivery schedules to track supplier performance and escalate potential delays or discrepancies.
  • Collaborates cross-functionally with Finance, Fulfillment, and Inbound teams to resolve invoice or receipt mismatches promptly. 
  • Maintains supplier records and documentation (e.g., W9s, insurance certs, contracts) in accordance with audit and compliance requirements. 
  • Assists in sourcing and supplier evaluation activities by gathering quotes, comparing pricing, and preparing summary data for review by Procurement Managers. 
  • Participates in process improvement initiatives focused on reducing manual effort, improving data accuracy, and shortening cycle times. 
  • Builds foundational knowledge in procurement systems (e.g., NetSuite, Coupa, or SAP), contract compliance, and category management to support future career progression.

lists.text: What experiences will help you in this role:
lists.content:
• In order to be successful in this role, you must have a combination of expertise and ability to understand the business.  
  • You have 0–2 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, or a related operations or administrative role. 
  • You have foundational understanding of procurement processes, POs, and invoice workflows. 
  • You have strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and document management. 
  • You are proficient in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets; experience with ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, or similar) is a plus. 
  • You demonstrate strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively across teams.

lists.text: How you will achieve success:
lists.content:
• Design and develop analytics models and tools to optimize transportation cost, speed, and network performance
  • Own and enhance key tools including carrier dashboards, routing optimizers, chargeback systems, and cost benchmarking engines
  • Deliver predictive and real-time reporting on key KPIs such as transit time, on-time delivery, and freight spend
  • Provide fast, ad hoc decision support with clear focus on business drivers and actionable insights (24-hour SLA)
  • Collaborate cross-functionally and support automation efforts while contributing to scalable, high-impact analytics solutions

lists.text: What experiences will help you  in this role:
lists.content:
• 4 to 6+ years of analytics experience, ideally in transportation, supply chain, logistics, or e commerce operations 
  • Strong SQL skills (Snowflake, Starburst, or similar) and advanced Excel; able to write and optimize complex queries independently; Power BI proficiency, including building dashboards and DAX measures from scratch.
  • Self directed problem solver who can take an ambiguous business question, scope it, pull the data, and deliver actionable insight with minimal oversight.
  • Excellent written and verbal English; comfortable presenting findings directly to US based leaders and stakeholders, has experience working across time zones with US teams.
  • Bonus: exposure to carrier rate analysis, freight cost modeling, or warehouse/inbound operations data.

lists.content:
• Lead the design and architecture of complex, high-scale services and integrations, from concept to production.
  • Drive technical direction and make the key architectural decisions that shape the team's roadmap.
  • Mentor and guide engineers, and raise the bar through thoughtful design and code reviews.
  • Own ambiguous, high-impact problems end-to-end — breaking them down and driving them to delivery.
  • Champion reliability, observability, automation, and operational excellence.
  • Partner closely with Product, Data, Infrastructure, and other engineering teams.
  • Stay hands-on: write high-quality, maintainable, well-tested code.

lists.text: What experiences will help you in this role:
lists.content:
• 7+ years of backend software engineering experience.
  • Deep system design and distributed systems expertise — you've designed and owned systems at scale.
  • A track record of technical leadership: mentoring engineers, influencing architecture, and setting engineering standards.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, a strong sense of ownership, and comfort with ambiguity.
  • Strong with cloud infrastructure (AWS or Azure), microservices, and event-driven architecture.
  • Strong debugging, testing, and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication and cross-team collaboration.
  • Nice-to-have: experience with high-throughput or marketplace/ecommerce systems.

lists.text: We invest heavily in our engineers. Here's what you can expect:
lists.content:
• Fully remote work — work from anywhere in India, with the creative freedom and work-life balance to do your best work.
  • Very competitive salary — we benchmark aggressively to attract top engineering talent.
  • Industry-leading health coverage — health insurance up to ₹30 Lakh, covering you, your family, and your parents.
  • Generous paid leave — a time-off policy that lets you truly recharge and prioritize your wellbeing.
  • Employer of Record (EOR) engagement — we handle payroll and tax compliance so you don't have to.

Spreetail is becoming a third-party logistics provider, taking on warehousing and fulfillment for external merchants and brands. The 3PL Staff Engineer owns the technical foundation of this new product: the multi-tenant systems that manage client onboarding, inventory, warehouse operations, order fulfillment, and billing for outside customers using Spreetail's fulfillment network.
You will operate as a founding technical leader for a 0-to-1 platform, bringing deep ecommerce domain expertise to bear on warehouse operations, inventory management, and order fulfillment at multi-tenant scale. This platform is being built AI-native from the start — with demand forecasting, automated exception handling, and anomaly detection woven into core workflows rather than bolted on afterward. Your work directly determines whether Spreetail can reliably sell 3PL services to external clients — making it a direct driver of new revenue and margin.
This is a hands-on, high-ownership, build-from-the-ground-up role requiring strong distributed systems expertise, deep familiarity with ecommerce order-to-fulfillment flows, and the ability to make foundational architecture decisions for a new business line.
 
 
 
Why Spreetail
 
Join a high-performing technology organization that values innovation, ownership, and collaboration. You’ll work with talented engineers who care deeply about building scalable systems and driving real business impact. Together, we’ll make Spreetail better.

lists.text: How you will achieve success:
lists.content:
A scalable, multi-tenant 3PL platform capable of onboarding external clients with distinct catalogs, inventory, and fulfillment rules
Reliable core systems for inventory management, order routing, and warehouse operations across client accounts
Fast, low-friction onboarding for new 3PL clients through configurable, reusable platform components
Accurate, real-time inventory and order visibility for both internal ops teams and external clients
Reliable, observable, self-healing fulfillment pipelines with clear SLAs clients can be sold against
Reduced manual intervention in exception handling (mis-ships, short-ships, returns, billing disputes) through AI-driven automation
Clear architectural direction as the 3PL platform scales from first clients to broad external adaptation.

lists.text: What experiences will help you in this role:
lists.content:
• 6–8+ years of experience building and shipping production backend systems
  • Experience informally or formally leading the technical direction of a team or workstream (design reviews, mentorship, setting standards)
  • Experience with ecommerce order management, inventory, warehouse, or logistics systems is a strong plus
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, still-being-defined 0-to-1 environment

    • Technical Skills

  • Strong fundamentals in backend engineering: APIs, data modeling, databases, and distributed systems
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and cloud-native service design
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures (queues, streams, async processing)
  • Strong testing, debugging, and production-support practices

    • Technical Leadership

  • Ability to set technical direction and make sound judgment calls without direct authority
  • Strong code review and mentorship instincts
  • Comfort representing a workstream in broader architecture discussions

    • Domain & AI Exposure (Nice to Have)

  • Exposure to EDI standards or 3PL/WMS integration patterns
  • Experience integrating ML model outputs (forecasts, predictions, anomaly scores) into application logic
  • Interest in growing domain expertise in e-commerce logistics and fulfillment

    • Collaboration & Communication

  • Ability to influence and align engineers without formal authority over them
  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially in async, distributed team settings
  • Comfort balancing hands-on technical work with guiding others

lists.text: Success in this role looks like:
lists.content:
• A well-architected, reliable set of services within your workstream (inventory, order, warehouse ops, or client-integration domain)
  • Engineers on your workstream shipping confidently because designs and technical direction are clear
  • Reduced manual intervention in exception handling within your area through automation and, where relevant, AI-assisted detection
  • Design docs and technical decisions that Staff engineers can review quickly and trust
  • Faster onboarding of new 3PL clients through well-built, reusable components in your workstream
  • Engineers around you leveling up through your code reviews, design guidance, and mentorship

lists.text: Key Responsibilities
lists.content:
Lead Technical Direction for Your Workstream

  • Own the technical design and quality of services within your workstream, such as:
  • Multi-client inventory management and warehouse allocation
  • Order intake, routing, and fulfillment orchestration
  • Shipment tracking and carrier integrations
  • Client onboarding and data integration (APIs, EDI, flat-file)
  • Returns and exception-handling workflows
  • Break down ambiguous problems into clear technical plans for the engineers on your workstream
  • Ensure designs align with overall platform architecture set by Staff engineers

    • Guide AI-Native Platform Capabilities Within Your Area

  • Lead the integration of forecasting, ETA prediction, or anomaly-detection signals into your workstream's fulfillment workflows
  • Partner with Staff engineers and data/ML engineers to translate model outputs into reliable operational logic
  • Set the standard for how exceptions and anomalies get detected and actioned automatically within your area

    • Lead Without Direct Reports

  • Act as the go-to technical decision-maker for engineers working in your workstream, without formal people-management authority
  • Run or contribute heavily to design reviews, unblocking technical debates with sound judgment
  • Mentor engineers through code review, pairing, and technical guidance
  • Flag people or delivery risks to the Engineering Manager, while staying focused on technical leadership yourself

    • Bring E-commerce & Logistics Domain Expertise

  • Apply strong knowledge of order-to-fulfillment flows to guide design decisions and catch edge cases early (backorders, split shipments, peak-volume spikes)
  • Guide the team on tradeoffs specific to multi-tenant clients with different fulfillment rules

    • Raise the Bar on Quality & Reliability

  • Set and enforce standards for testing, observability, and reliability within your workstream
  • Proactively identify and drive down technical debt as the platform scales
  • Ensure your workstream's services are well-documented and easy for others to build on

    • Collaborate Across the Team

  • Work closely with Staff engineers, product, and operations stakeholders to clarify requirements and priorities
  • Represent your workstream in cross-team architecture discussions
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs and risks clearly to both engineers and stakeholders

    •

lists.text: Experience & Key Skills
lists.content:
Experience

  • 6–8+ years of experience building and shipping production backend systems
  • Experience informally or formally leading the technical direction of a team or workstream (design reviews, mentorship, setting standards)
  • Experience with e-commerce order management, inventory, warehouse, or logistics systems is a strong plus
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, still-being-defined 0-to-1 environment

    • Technical Skills

  • Strong fundamentals in backend engineering: APIs, data modeling, databases, and distributed systems
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and cloud-native service design
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures (queues, streams, async processing)
  • Strong testing, debugging, and production-support practices

    • Technical Leadership

  • Ability to set technical direction and make sound judgment calls without direct authority
  • Strong code review and mentorship instincts
  • Comfort representing a workstream in broader architecture discussions

    • Domain & AI Exposure (Nice to Have)

  • Exposure to EDI standards or 3PL/WMS integration patterns
  • Experience integrating ML model outputs (forecasts, predictions, anomaly scores) into application logic
  • Interest in growing domain expertise in ecommerce logistics and fulfillment

    • Collaboration & Communication

  • Ability to influence and align engineers without formal authority over them
  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially in async, distributed team settings
  • Comfort balancing hands-on technical work with guiding others

Spreetail is seeking a Senior Analyst to join our Marketing Operations team. In this role, you will continuously innovate our marketing analytics, ensuring all processes and tools are well-documented and supported through training. If you are passionate about automating tools and reducing errors while cross-collaborating, keep scrolling.

lists.text: How you will achieve success:
lists.content:
• Design and develop advanced analytics models and tooling infrastructure to optimize marketing processes and tooling. 
  • Oversee and enhance tools like Promotions Optimization, Alerting Dashboard, Brand Workflow Engine, and Channel Search Optimization. Develop new tools required for new business pursuits or advancing current operations. 
  • Continuously monitor marketing processes and performance through advanced data analytics. Work to produce predictive analytics models that the reporting teams can utilize to support key marketing metrics 1+ year in advance (Impact, Lift%, Suppression Risk, Lost Sales from Alerting, etc.).
  • Provide data-driven insights for ad hoc marketing decisions, supporting the marketing management team with necessary data and tools. Ensure the analysis explains business drivers ($s) vs. count metrics. 
  • Work closely with departments like Merchandising, Planners, Training, S&T, FP&A, Pricing, and Demand to align marketing management with market demands. Ensure built solutions can scale (reduce time and increase efficiency) through 5+ years.

lists.text: What experiences will help you in this role:
lists.content:
• Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 2-5 years of experience in business analytics; Including SQL and Excel as well as data visualization tools (PowerBI, Tableau, etc.).
  • Experience with scripting languages (Python, R).
  • Advanced problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and deliver actionable insights in business terms (increased revenue, reduced costs, mitigated risk).
  • Strong numerical and analytical aptitude and high proficiency in creating and managing advanced models.

lists.text: How you will achieve success:

  • Establishes foundational architecture that supports rapid feature expansion and multi-tenant growth.
  • Balances speed of delivery with long-term maintainability.
  • Implements secure, reliable, observable systems aligned with SaaS best practices.
  • Creates extensible APIs and UI layers that enable internal and external consumers.
  • Drives engineering standards across testing, CI/CD, code quality, and documentation.

  • Acts as a technical leader and mentor while remaining hands-on.

  • Proven experience building or significantly contributing to e-commerce SaaS platforms.
  • Experience working in high-growth, scaling environments.
  • Strong backend development experience (Python).
  • Strong frontend development experience (React)
  • Experience designing RESTful or GraphQL APIs.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems and system design.
  • Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP).
  • Experience with CI/CD, DevOps practices, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Knowledge of secure software design principles.

lists.text: How you will achieve success:
lists.content:
• Design and develop advanced analytics models and tooling infrastructure to optimize inventory levels and procurement.  
  • Oversee and enhance tools like ROB (Replenishment Open to Buy), NPR (New Part number Research), Inventory Control Tower, and Inbound/Freight Optimization for efficient order quantity generation and allocation. Develop new tools required for new business pursuits or advancing current operations.  
  • Ensure prompt response to business insights needs and tooling requisitions, adhering to an SLA set response window.  
  • Continuously monitor inventory levels and performance through advanced data analytics. Work to produce predictive analytics models that the reporting teams can utilize to support key inventory metrics 1+ years in advance (COH, Receipts, OOS, Inventory Turn, Lost Sales, Allocation %, etc.).
  • Provide data-driven insights for ad hoc inventory decisions, supporting the inventory management team with necessary data and tools. Ensure the analysis explains business drivers ($s) vs. count metrics.

lists.text: What experiences will help you in this role:
lists.content:
• Multiple years of progressive experience in high-volume fulfillment, manufacturing, or distribution; e-commerce expertise is strongly preferred to navigate our unique pace and customer-centric complexity.
  • A minimum of 5+ years in a leadership capacity, with a demonstrated ability to transition from tactical oversight to high-level strategic planning and execution.
  • A track record of successfully leading large-scale operations (headcounts of 50+ team members) across single or multi-site environments, maintaining operational integrity during rapid growth and seasonal peaks.
  • Expert-level skill in identifying, assessing, and onboarding "Bar Raising" talent. You have a disciplined approach to recruitment that ensures every hire elevates the existing team’s capabilities.
  • A demonstrated commitment to Radical Candor—the ability to provide and solicit direct, actionable feedback (both constructive and reinforcing) across all levels of the organization to drive continuous improvement.
  • Experience managing complex labor and capacity models to balance fluctuating global inbound freight with rigorous, on-time outbound shipping expectations.
  • A history of building and protecting a high-performance culture rooted in "Extreme Ownership," transparency, and a safety-first mindset.
